mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, run_id, parent_step_id, trigger_tool_call_id, owner_epoch, round_no, title, status, frozen_json, request_fingerprint, join_step_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_creative_delegation WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, run_id, upstream_step_id, downstream_step_id, join_policy, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_creative_step_dependency WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, run_id, max_steps, max_depth, max_parallel, max_repair_rounds, max_invocations, max_reserved_turns, used_invocations, reserved_turns, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_creative_run_budget WHERE run_id = #{runId}
SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM manga_creative_delegation WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'MATERIALIZED') ORDER BY run_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_creative_step SET status = #{to}, owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, owner_epoch = owner_epoch + 1, schedule_version = schedule_version + CASE WHEN #{to} = 'READY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, max_attempts = CASE WHEN #{to} = 'READY' THEN attempt_no + #{retryAttempts} ELSE max_attempts END, state_session_id = COALESCE(#{sessionId}, state_session_id), continuation_json = COALESCE(#{continuation}, continuation_json), output_json = COALESCE(#{output}, output_json), error_code = COALESCE(#{errorCode}, error_code), error_message = COALESCE(#{errorMessage}, error_message), finished_at = CASE WHEN #{to} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED', 'CANCELLED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE finished_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE step_id = #{stepId} AND status = #{from}
UPDATE manga_agent_session SET status = 'RETIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE state_session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE manga_creative_step SET state_session_id = #{sessionId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE step_id = #{stepId} AND status = 'READY'
